propositions: Every acceptance-criterion item must be independently classified as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested with criterion-specific evidence, not keyword-only detection.

The exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] token selects ticket-attestation evidence; missing or malformed tags on external criteria must produce findings naming the exact syntax, while exact tags on external criteria are accepted.

A codebase-verifiable criterion incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must produce a finding explaining repository proof cannot be substituted by ticket comments; untagged codebase criteria are accepted.
Criteria bundling both repository and external-world proof must be rejected with guidance to split into independently certifiable criteria, not silently assigned one evidence kind.

Misclassification findings participate in normal validity×impact blocking policy with ≥0.90 macro precision/recall and 100% precision on genuine-external negatives; deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.
